scholarships.title: Government Scholarship in Saudi Public Universities for Non-Saudi Students (external scholarship) - Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
scholarships.degree: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, Higher Diploma, Diploma in Arabic for non-native speakers
scholarships.funding_label: Government scholarship, coverage varies by university
scholarships.official_source: Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Study in Saudi platform)

existing.description: The Saudi Ministry of Education runs a government scholarship programme that lets non-Saudi students study at the Kingdom's 27 public universities. Applicants apply directly to a Saudi public university for admission, or through the Saudi Cultural Attache in their country, or through the Saudi Embassy where no Cultural Attache exists. The Ministry classifies awards as external scholarships for students from outside the Kingdom, or internal scholarships for non-Saudis already holding legal residence in the Kingdom.
eligibility: Non-Saudi national (external scholarship applicants must be from outside the Kingdom)
Meet the admission requirements applicable to Saudis at the receiving institution
Age not less than 17 and not more than 25 for undergraduate or Arabic-language institute study
Age not more than 30 for a master's degree and not more than 35 for a doctoral degree
Where the applicant's own country requires it, that government must approve the study in the Kingdom
Must not already hold another scholarship from an educational institution in the Kingdom
Must not have been dismissed from any educational institution in the Kingdom
Must present a certificate of absence of precedents from the security services of their country
Must pass the medical examination set by the applicable regulations
Certificates and supporting papers attested by the authorities specified by the institution
Female students covered by a scholarship or regular residence must comply with the mahram rules
existing.eligibility_summary: Non-Saudi applicants who meet the admission requirements that apply to Saudi students at the same institution, are within the published age limits, and hold an attested certificate of no criminal precedents from their own country.
benefits: Tuition fees waived (the Ministry states scholarship students study free of charge and without tuition fees)
Health care for the student and, where regulations require, family members residing with him
Housing, where the institution grants it under a type B partial scholarship
Annual travel tickets, according to the applicable regulations
Access to facilities enjoyed by other students of the receiving institution
coverage: Tuition-free study for international scholarship students at Saudi public universities, plus institution-specific benefits; the Ministry states the Kingdom provides sponsorship free of charge and without tuition fees, with other advantages set by each institution
requirements: Apply to a Saudi public university for a programme open to international scholarship students (health and medical specialisations are excluded at the post-secondary stage by the Ministry)
Attach the Saudi Cultural Attache or Saudi Embassy in the country of residence where applicable
Comply with the receiving institution's own admission rules and any recommendation it requires
documents: Admission application to the chosen Saudi public university
Attested academic certificates and supporting papers
Certificate of absence of precedents from the security services of the country of nationality
existing.english_requirement: Not stated on the Ministry page; individual universities set their own language requirements for the programmes offered.
application_method: Apply online with the Saudi public university of choice during that university's published admission window
Apply through the Saudi Cultural Attache in the country of nationality, or the Embassy of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia where no Cultural Attache exists
Use the Study in Saudi platform (https://studyinsaudi.sa) for the central application route
existing.selection_notes: Admission follows the same conditions as for Saudi students; the educational institution council sets the executive rules and decides the level of benefit granted (full, partial or paid).
existing.best_fit: Non-Arab and Arab students from Africa, Asia and the wider world who hold a national upper-secondary qualification and want a government-funded degree at a Saudi public university.
existing.notes: The scheme has three benefit levels set by each institution: type A full scholarship with full benefits, type B partial scholarship (seat only, or seat plus housing) and type C paid grant. Not every participating university offers type A at every level, so the award should not be treated as uniformly fully funded.
existing.duration: Programme length follows the degree studied; the Ministry page sets age ceilings of 25 for undergraduate and Arabic-diploma study, 30 for master's and 35 for doctoral study
existing.application_period: Per academic year, at each participating university; the Study in Saudi platform publishes semester-based application windows
existing.deadline_display: October 28, 2026 (per the official Ghana Scholarships Authority notice for the current recruitment round; the Ministry states that each university sets its own opening date for each academic year)
